name: Dollie Hub – Build Your Own WordPress Cloud Platform
author: GetDollie

sections.description:
Beware – Dollie is now the All in One Platform for WordPress Pros. This is a legacy plugin which is not functional anymore. Please visit https://control.getdollie.com/register to get started

Everything your agency needs to thrive. Dollie is the all-in-one platform for WordPress professionals, combining white-label hosting, site care, and client management into a single dashboard.

Everything Your Agency Needs to Thrive

Dollie empowers agencies, freelancers, and developers to manage every aspect of their WordPress business in one platform. From white-label hosting to site care and client management, Dollie helps you grow your revenue, optimize your operations, and elevate your services.

Get Started for Free at https://getdollie.com

Key Features

Grow Your Business

  • White-Label Hosting
    Boost your revenue by offering premium hosting under your own brand and domain.

  • Next-Gen Site Management
    Manage all your client sites from a centralized, user-friendly dashboard.

  • Client Hub (Coming Soon)
    Build a branded client portal for invoicing, support, and onboarding directly on your WordPress site.

Optimize Operations with Site Care

  • Automated Backups
    Daily scheduled backups sent directly to your S3 storage or our Vault.

  • Uptime Monitoring
    Get notified of downtime before your clients do.

  • Security Scans
    Stay ahead of vulnerabilities with automated security checks.

  • Global Activity Logs
    Track team actions and scheduled updates across all sites.

  • Update Manager
    Bulk update plugins, themes, and WordPress core in seconds.

  • Site Reports
    Generate PDF reports summarizing site care activities, perfect for client updates.

Intelligence Suite

Proactively monitor and manage site performance, security, and resource usage.
– Performance Insights
Gain real-time insights into Core Web Vitals, SEO, and more.
– Audit Logs
Troubleshoot easily with detailed logs of activity and errors.
– Traffic Monitoring
Keep track of traffic spikes and resource consumption.

Smart AI Assistance

Streamline your workload with AI tools that assist—not replace—your team.
– Custom Assistants for SEO, email drafts, coding, and more.
– Client Communication with automated, customized reports and proposals.

What Our Users Say

“The Dollie team moved all our client sites to white-label hosting. Our team loves the control panel, and our sites have gotten faster too!”
— Anna Schumacher

“We can now bill customers directly via our own Agency Hub. Clients love having invoices, onboarding docs, and live chat in one branded portal!”
— Sarah James

“Our team has fallen in love with Dollie. The Intelligence Suite has been a game-changer for SEO and performance work.”
— Ben Wooldridge

Get Started for Free

Dollie offers everything you need to streamline your WordPress business:
– Centralized Site Management
– Automated Backups & Monitoring
– AI-Powered Features
– White-Label Hosting

Sign up today and start building your WordPress empire!
